title: 13 links that explain today's penny-stock bloodbath. One name gaveback 72% in a single session. What else got shredded?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Penny stocks got shredded. Golden Heaven gave back 72% today, erasing  
most of Monday's 91% pop, Bridger Aerospace lost 39% and Global Mofy  
35%. House of Doge is down 94% in 30 days. High risk, high drama.  
Today's overview of the sub-$5 wreckage is below — read before you  
touch any of them.  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Golden Heaven Group Holdings (GDHG)\*\* — GDHG tumbled from  
Monday's $1.58 close to $0.4425, a -72.15% move, during Tuesday's  
regular session, erasing the bulk of the prior day's +91.45% gain. No  
verified news or fundamental catalyst found: there was no new company  
release, filing or analyst action behind the drop.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-golden-heaven-group-holdings-ltd-gdhg-stock-down-71-52-today-39776/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-golden-heaven-group-holdings-ltd-gdhg-stock-down-71-52-today-39776/)  
  
\*\*2. Bridger Aerospace Group (BAER)\*\* — BAER closed Monday at $0.2404  
and last traded at $0.1461, a -39.23% decline, gapping lower premarket  
and extending the drop in Tuesday's regular session. The catalyst was  
Monday's post-close Q3 report: EPS of $0.37 missed the $0.61 consensus  
and revenue of $76.4M fell short of about $80.3M, while FY2026  
guidance was cut to $124M-$128M revenue and $36M-$39M adjusted EBITDA  
from $135M-$145M and $55M-$60M.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-bridger-aerospace-group-holdings-baer-stock-down-39-02-today-39777/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-bridger-aerospace-group-holdings-baer-stock-down-39-02-today-39777/)  
  
\*\*3. Global Mofy AI (GMM)\*\* — GMM dropped from Monday's close of $2.01  
to $1.30 early Tuesday, a -35.32% decline recorded during regular  
market hours after premarket quotes had already shown a deep gap down.  
No verified news or fundamental catalyst found: no fresh filing,  
release or analyst action accompanied today's slide, making it  
consistent with profit-taking that reversed Monday's +97.06%  
Anthropic-driven spike in a micro-cap...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-global-mofy-ai-limited-gmm-stock-down-35-32-today-39775/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-global-mofy-ai-limited-gmm-stock-down-35-32-today-39775/)  
  
\*\*4. Scilex Holding Company (SCLX)\*\* — SCLX fell from a $1.25 close on  
Nov. 16 to $0.82 in early regular-session trading on Nov. 17, a drop  
of -34.24%, after opening near $1.23 and sliding through the first 20  
minutes of trading. No verified news or fundamental catalyst found: no  
release, filing or analyst action explains the gap.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-scilex-holding-company-sclx-stock-down-34-40-today-39780/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-scilex-holding-company-sclx-stock-down-34-40-today-39780/)  
  
\*\*5. Kyntra Bio (KYNB)\*\* — KYNB fell from a $3.20 previous close to  
$2.20, a -31.25% drop, in the opening stretch of Tuesday's regular  
session. The catalyst: Q3 2026 results released after Monday's close  
disclosed that a pre-specified interim analysis showed insufficient  
efficacy for FG-3246 in metastatic castration-resistant prostate  
cancer, prompting termination of its Phase 2 trial and discontinuation  
of FG-3180.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-kyntra-bio-kynb-stock-down-29-69-today-39781/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-kyntra-bio-kynb-stock-down-29-69-today-39781/)  
  
\*\*6. Red Cat (RCAT)\*\* — RCAT fell -26.06%, dropping from Monday's  
$3.53 close to $2.61. The bulk of the decline came in after-hours and  
overnight trading once results were released post-close, then carried  
into Tuesday's opening session.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-red-cat-holdings-rcat-stock-down-26-06-today-39761/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-red-cat-holdings-rcat-stock-down-26-06-today-39761/)  
  
\*\*7. Workhorse Group (WKHS)\*\* — Workhorse Group shares dropped  
\-22.64%, falling from Monday's $2.65 close to $2.05, with the decline  
concentrated in Tuesday's regular session following a $2.57 open. The  
move followed third-quarter 2026 results released after Monday's  
close: revenue of $6.1M versus roughly $9.2M expected, and a net loss  
of $21.8M, or -$2.00 per share against -$0.61 consensus.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-workhorse-group-inc-wkhs-stock-down-24-15-today-39790/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-workhorse-group-inc-wkhs-stock-down-24-15-today-39790/)  
  
\*\*8. Datavault AI (DVLT)\*\* — Datavault AI gapped down sharply in  
premarket and closed the November 16 regular session at $0.0280, down  
\-53.33% from Friday's $0.0600 close, finishing at the low of a  
$0.0280–$0.0523 range. The catalyst was the company's November 13  
after-close disclosure that Nasdaq will suspend trading in its common  
stock effective November 17 for failing the $1.00 minimum bid price  
rule and the 10-cent low-price rule...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-datavault-ai-inc-dvlt-stock-down-53-33-today-39779/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-datavault-ai-inc-dvlt-stock-down-53-33-today-39779/)  
  
\*\*9. Accendra Health (ACH)\*\* — ACH closed at $0.0857, down -35.08%  
from the previous close of $0.1320, with the selling concentrated in  
Monday's regular session before the shares were halted; the stock  
remains suspended. The catalyst was the NYSE's determination to  
commence delisting proceedings under Section 802.01D for "abnormally  
low selling price," announced at 4:00 p.m. ET with trading suspended  
immediately — the terminal step...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-accendra-health-ach-stock-down-35-08-today-39782/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-accendra-health-ach-stock-down-35-08-today-39782/)  
  
\*\*10. Cyabra (CYAB)\*\* — Cyabra fell from Monday's close of $0.1368 to  
$0.096, a -29.82% move, with selling starting in premarket near -26%  
and continuing through Tuesday's regular session. The drop unwinds  
Monday's +53.71% financing-driven surge: the up-to-$40 million  
securities purchase agreement converts at $0.15 through Series D  
preferred and warrants, while roughly 16.1 million existing warrants  
were repriced to $0.15 — a...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-cyabra-inc-cyab-stock-down-31-37-today-39784/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-cyabra-inc-cyab-stock-down-31-37-today-39784/)  
  
\*\*11. DDC Enterprise (DDC)\*\* — DDC closed at $0.0865 on Nov. 16, down  
\-33.46% from the prior close of $0.1300, with most of the damage  
arriving in a single late-afternoon burst during the regular session  
after a roughly flat open. The driver was sector-level, not  
company-specific: bitcoin slid to about $62,000–$64,600 over the  
weekend, a three-month low, and crypto-treasury equities sold off with  
it.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-ddc-enterprise-limited-ddc-stock-down-33-46-today-39778/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-ddc-enterprise-limited-ddc-stock-down-33-46-today-39778/)  
  
\*\*12. House of Doge (HODO)\*\* — House of Doge (HODO) shares fell  
roughly 94% over the past 30 days, sliding from about $0.09 to the  
sub-penny range as several crises converged at once.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/house-of-doge-hodo-stock-drops-94-in-30-days-as-multiple-challenges-converge-39663/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/house-of-doge-hodo-stock-drops-94-in-30-days-as-multiple-challenges-converge-39663/)  
  
\*\*13. Flux Power (FLUX)\*\* — FLUX shares have fallen roughly 32% over  
the last 30 days, declining from about $0.42 in mid-October to near  
$0.29 as of mid-November 2026.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/flux-power-holdings-flux-drops-32-over-30-days-as-takeover-premium-unwinds-39656/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/flux-power-holdings-flux-drops-32-over-30-days-as-takeover-premium-unwinds-39656/)  
  
Any of these sub-$5 names still interesting after today's wreckage, or  
is this stay-away territory?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
